verdict.rationale: Intercom publishes an official TypeScript/Node SDK (intercom-node) that wraps the Intercom APIs. It includes Fin-relevant AI content endpoints such as createContentImportSource and provides pagination iterators, and the Fin Agent API is documented for programmatic access. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in other languages, confirmation that the SDK covers the Fin Agent API orchestration endpoints (which are Preview-only), and independent hands-on corroboration.
